text_block_list.text:
Air Groove delivers a splendid run all the 
way through the Oka Sho.

Having faced formidable rivals, she burned 
with fighting spirit, anticipating that 
the remaining two races would be just as 
daunting.

To put on an even better performance at 
the Yushun Himba (Oaks) than at the Oka 
Sho, Air Groove kept her guard up and 
began preparing for what lay ahead.
